## Biology

Seel is a [pinniped](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/pinniped "wp:pinniped")[Pokémon](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_(species) "Pokémon (species)") with a thick hide covered in bluish-white fur. It has a pale tan canine maw with a large red tongue and a pair of tusks on its lower jaw. It has circular eyes, prominent black eyebrows (it’s one of the few Pokémon that has eyebrows) and a black nose that is capable of closing when it swims. There is a small horn on its forehead, which it uses in combination with its tusks to bore through ice floes. It has two flippers on its chest, and two more on the end of its tail. When the tail is raised, it resembles a waterspout.

Seel lives on icebergs in [frigid ocean waters.](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/List_of_Pok%C3%A9mon_by_habitat#Sea_Pok%C3%A9mon "List of Pokémon by habitat") Its warm fur and thick hide allow it to swim in waters as cold as −40° Fahrenheit (−40° Celsius). It thrives in these cold environments, becoming more active as the temperature drops and tires easily in warm waters. Preferring to sleep during the day, it hunts for prey under sheets of ice in the late day and evening hours. While it is a graceful swimmer, it is awkward and struggles to move on dry land.

### Evolution

Seel evolves into [Dewgong](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Dewgong_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Dewgong (Pokémon)").

## Biology

Seel is a [pinniped](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/pinniped "wp:pinniped")[Pokémon](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_(species) "Pokémon (species)") with a thick hide covered in bluish-white fur. It has a pale tan canine maw with a large red tongue and a pair of tusks on its lower jaw. It has circular eyes, prominent black eyebrows (it’s one of the few Pokémon that has eyebrows) and a black nose that is capable of closing when it swims. There is a small horn on its forehead, which it uses in combination with its tusks to bore through ice floes. It has two flippers on its chest, and two more on the end of its tail. When the tail is raised, it resembles a waterspout.

Seel lives on icebergs in [frigid ocean waters.](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/List_of_Pok%C3%A9mon_by_habitat#Sea_Pok%C3%A9mon "List of Pokémon by habitat") Its warm fur and thick hide allow it to swim in waters as cold as −40° Fahrenheit (−40° Celsius). It thrives in these cold environments, becoming more active as the temperature drops and tires easily in warm waters. Preferring to sleep during the day, it hunts for prey under sheets of ice in the late day and evening hours. While it is a graceful swimmer, it is awkward and struggles to move on dry land.

### Evolution

Seel evolves into [Dewgong](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Dewgong_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Dewgong (Pokémon)").

**Squirtle** ([Japanese](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/List_of_Japanese_Pok%C3%A9mon_names "List of Japanese Pokémon names"): **ゼニガメ**_Zenigame_) is a [Water-type](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Water_(type) "Water (type)")[Pokémon](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_(species) "Pokémon (species)") introduced in [Generation I](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Generation_I "Generation I").

It [evolves](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Evolution "Evolution") into [Wartortle](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Wartortle_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Wartortle (Pokémon)") starting at [level](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Level "Level") 16, which evolves into [Blastoise](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Blastoise_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Blastoise (Pokémon)") starting at [level](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Level "Level") 36.

Along with [Bulbasaur](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Bulbasaur_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Bulbasaur (Pokémon)") and [Charmander](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Charmander_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Charmander (Pokémon)"), Squirtle is one of the three [first partner Pokémon of Kanto](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Kanto_first_partner_Pok%C3%A9mon "Kanto first partner Pokémon") available at the beginning of [Pokémon Red, Green](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_Red_and_Green_Versions "Pokémon Red and Green Versions"), [Blue](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_Red_and_Blue_Versions "Pokémon Red and Blue Versions"), [FireRed, and LeafGreen](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_FireRed_and_LeafGreen_Versions "Pokémon FireRed and LeafGreen Versions").

## Biology

[![Image 31](https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/e/ea/May_Squirtle_Withdraw.png/200px-May_Squirtle_Withdraw.png)](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/File:May_Squirtle_Withdraw.png)

Squirtle in its shell

Squirtle is a small [reptilian](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/reptile "wp:reptile")[Pokémon](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_(species) "Pokémon (species)") that resembles a light-blue [turtle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Testudines "wp:Testudines"). While it typically walks on its two short legs, it has been shown to run on all fours in [Super Smash Bros. Brawl](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Super_Smash_Bros._Brawl "Super Smash Bros. Brawl"). It has large, purplish, or reddish eyes and a slightly hooked upper lip. Each of its hands and feet has three pointed digits. The end of its long, squirrel-like tail curls inward. Its body is encased by a tough shell that forms and hardens after birth. This shell is brown on the top, pale yellow on the bottom, and has a thick white ridge between the two halves.

Squirtle's shell is a useful tool. It can withdraw into its shell for protection or to sleep. The grooved, rounded shape helps to reduce water resistance, allowing the Pokémon to swim at high speeds. Squirtle can spray foamy water from its mouth with great accuracy. Squirtle is scarce in the wild, although it can be found [around small ponds and lakes](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/List_of_Pok%C3%A9mon_by_habitat#Water's_Edge_Pok%C3%A9mon "List of Pokémon by habitat"). Squirtle can also be found residing around rivers in mountainous regions, as shown in [Pokémon Snap](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_Snap "Pokémon Snap") and [Pokémon Scarlet and Violet](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_Scarlet_and_Violet "Pokémon Scarlet and Violet"). In the [_Pokémon the Series: The Beginning_](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Original_series "Original series") episode _[Beach Blank-Out Blastoise](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP060 "EP060")_, Squirtle is shown to be found living on secluded islands with other members of their [evolutionary](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Evolution "Evolution") line. [Sharpedo](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Sharpedo_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Sharpedo (Pokémon)") is a natural predator of Squirtle. As shown in [Pokémon Sleep](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_Sleep "Pokémon Sleep"), Squirtle is known to sleep by withdrawing its limbs and head into its shell to protect itself from threats.[[1]](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Squirtle_(Pok%C3%A9mon)#cite_note-1)

In [Generation II](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Generation_II "Generation II"), Squirtle and its evolved forms were the [only known Pokémon](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Signature_move "Signature move") capable of learning the [move](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Move "Move")[Skull Bash](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Skull_Bash_(move) "Skull Bash (move)") naturally, but other Pokémon could still inherit it via [breeding](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_breeding "Pokémon breeding").

### Evolution

Squirtle evolves into [Wartortle](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Wartortle_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Wartortle (Pokémon)"), which evolves into [Blastoise](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Blastoise_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Blastoise (Pokémon)").

(For specifics on this Pokémon's Evolution in the games, refer to [Game data→Evolution data](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Squirtle_(Pok%C3%A9mon)#Evolution_data).)

### NPC appearances

*   If the player chose [Charmander](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Charmander_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Charmander (Pokémon)"), the player's [rival](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Rival "Rival"), [Blue](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Blue_(game) "Blue (game)"), will pick Squirtle in [Generation I](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Generation_I "Generation I") and [Pokémon FireRed and LeafGreen](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_FireRed_and_LeafGreen "Pokémon FireRed and LeafGreen"). Blue will use this Squirtle in his first three battles against the player before it evolves into [Wartortle](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Wartortle_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Wartortle (Pokémon)").
*   [Professor Sycamore](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Professor_Sycamore "Professor Sycamore") will use a Squirtle in his first battle against the player in [Pokémon X and Y](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_X_and_Y "Pokémon X and Y").
*   [Pokémon Pokopia](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_Pokopia "Pokémon Pokopia"): Squirtle is the very first Pokémon that can be befriended. When found laying on the ground and in need of hydration, [Ditto](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Ditto_(Pokopia) "Ditto (Pokopia)") learns [Water Gun](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Water_Gun_(move) "Water Gun (move)") and uses it on Squirtle to help them.

**Squirtle** ([Japanese](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/List_of_Japanese_Pok%C3%A9mon_names "List of Japanese Pokémon names"): **ゼニガメ**_Zenigame_) is a [Water-type](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Water_(type) "Water (type)")[Pokémon](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_(species) "Pokémon (species)") introduced in [Generation I](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Generation_I "Generation I").

It [evolves](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Evolution "Evolution") into [Wartortle](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Wartortle_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Wartortle (Pokémon)") starting at [level](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Level "Level") 16, which evolves into [Blastoise](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Blastoise_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Blastoise (Pokémon)") starting at [level](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Level "Level") 36.

Along with [Bulbasaur](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Bulbasaur_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Bulbasaur (Pokémon)") and [Charmander](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Charmander_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Charmander (Pokémon)"), Squirtle is one of the three [first partner Pokémon of Kanto](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Kanto_first_partner_Pok%C3%A9mon "Kanto first partner Pokémon") available at the beginning of [Pokémon Red, Green](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_Red_and_Green_Versions "Pokémon Red and Green Versions"), [Blue](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_Red_and_Blue_Versions "Pokémon Red and Blue Versions"), [FireRed, and LeafGreen](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_FireRed_and_LeafGreen_Versions "Pokémon FireRed and LeafGreen Versions").

## Biology

[![Image 31](https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/e/ea/May_Squirtle_Withdraw.png/200px-May_Squirtle_Withdraw.png)](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/File:May_Squirtle_Withdraw.png)

Squirtle in its shell

Squirtle is a small [reptilian](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/reptile "wp:reptile")[Pokémon](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_(species) "Pokémon (species)") that resembles a light-blue [turtle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Testudines "wp:Testudines"). While it typically walks on its two short legs, it has been shown to run on all fours in [Super Smash Bros. Brawl](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Super_Smash_Bros._Brawl "Super Smash Bros. Brawl"). It has large, purplish, or reddish eyes and a slightly hooked upper lip. Each of its hands and feet has three pointed digits. The end of its long, squirrel-like tail curls inward. Its body is encased by a tough shell that forms and hardens after birth. This shell is brown on the top, pale yellow on the bottom, and has a thick white ridge between the two halves.

Squirtle's shell is a useful tool. It can withdraw into its shell for protection or to sleep. The grooved, rounded shape helps to reduce water resistance, allowing the Pokémon to swim at high speeds. Squirtle can spray foamy water from its mouth with great accuracy. Squirtle is scarce in the wild, although it can be found [around small ponds and lakes](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/List_of_Pok%C3%A9mon_by_habitat#Water's_Edge_Pok%C3%A9mon "List of Pokémon by habitat"). Squirtle can also be found residing around rivers in mountainous regions, as shown in [Pokémon Snap](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_Snap "Pokémon Snap") and [Pokémon Scarlet and Violet](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_Scarlet_and_Violet "Pokémon Scarlet and Violet"). In the [_Pokémon the Series: The Beginning_](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Original_series "Original series") episode _[Beach Blank-Out Blastoise](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/EP060 "EP060")_, Squirtle is shown to be found living on secluded islands with other members of their [evolutionary](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Evolution "Evolution") line. [Sharpedo](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Sharpedo_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Sharpedo (Pokémon)") is a natural predator of Squirtle. As shown in [Pokémon Sleep](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_Sleep "Pokémon Sleep"), Squirtle is known to sleep by withdrawing its limbs and head into its shell to protect itself from threats.[[1]](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Squirtle_(Pok%C3%A9mon)#cite_note-1)

In [Generation II](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Generation_II "Generation II"), Squirtle and its evolved forms were the [only known Pokémon](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Signature_move "Signature move") capable of learning the [move](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Move "Move")[Skull Bash](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Skull_Bash_(move) "Skull Bash (move)") naturally, but other Pokémon could still inherit it via [breeding](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_breeding "Pokémon breeding").

### Evolution

Squirtle evolves into [Wartortle](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Wartortle_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Wartortle (Pokémon)"), which evolves into [Blastoise](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Blastoise_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Blastoise (Pokémon)").

(For specifics on this Pokémon's Evolution in the games, refer to [Game data→Evolution data](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Squirtle_(Pok%C3%A9mon)#Evolution_data).)

### NPC appearances

*   If the player chose [Charmander](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Charmander_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Charmander (Pokémon)"), the player's [rival](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Rival "Rival"), [Blue](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Blue_(game) "Blue (game)"), will pick Squirtle in [Generation I](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Generation_I "Generation I") and [Pokémon FireRed and LeafGreen](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_FireRed_and_LeafGreen "Pokémon FireRed and LeafGreen"). Blue will use this Squirtle in his first three battles against the player before it evolves into [Wartortle](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Wartortle_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Wartortle (Pokémon)").
*   [Professor Sycamore](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Professor_Sycamore "Professor Sycamore") will use a Squirtle in his first battle against the player in [Pokémon X and Y](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_X_and_Y "Pokémon X and Y").
*   [Pokémon Pokopia](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_Pokopia "Pokémon Pokopia"): Squirtle is the very first Pokémon that can be befriended. When found laying on the ground and in need of hydration, [Ditto](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Ditto_(Pokopia) "Ditto (Pokopia)") learns [Water Gun](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Water_Gun_(move) "Water Gun (move)") and uses it on Squirtle to help them.

## Biology

Psyduck is a yellow [Pokémon](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_(species) "Pokémon (species)") resembling a [duck](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/duck "wp:duck") or a bipedal [platypus](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/platypus "wp:platypus"). On top of its head are three thick strands of black hair, and it has a wide, flat cream-colored beak. Psyduck's eyes seem vacant and have tiny pupils. Its legs and tail are stubby, and it has cream-colored webbed feet. There are three claws on each of its hands.

Psyduck is constantly stunned by its [headache](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/headache "wp:headache") and is unable to think very clearly. It usually stands immobile, trying to calm its headache. However, when its headache becomes too severe, Psyduck releases tension in the form of strong psychic powers. The use of these powers produces brain waves identical to those seen in sleepers, and the Pokémon is unable to recall these episodes. Psyduck lives in [freshwater lakes](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/List_of_Pok%C3%A9mon_by_habitat#Water's-edge_Pok%C3%A9mon "List of Pokémon by habitat") and small ponds, but can be seen in rivers in tropical areas as shown in [Pokémon Snap](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_Snap "Pokémon Snap"). As mentioned in [Pokémon Sleep](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_Sleep "Pokémon Sleep"), Psyduck suffers headaches while it sleeps,[[1]](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Psyduck_(Pok%C3%A9mon)#cite_note-1) but very rarely, there have been sightings of Psyduck sleeping peacefully while not holding its head.

Prior to [Generation V](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Generation_V "Generation V"), Psyduck and its evolved form, [Golduck](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Golduck_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Golduck (Pokémon)"), were the [only known Pokémon](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Signature_Ability "Signature Ability") that could have [Cloud Nine](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Cloud_Nine_(Ability) "Cloud Nine (Ability)") as an [Ability](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Ability "Ability").

**Psyduck** ([Japanese](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/List_of_Japanese_Pok%C3%A9mon_names "List of Japanese Pokémon names"): **コダック**_Koduck_) is a [Water-type](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Water_(type) "Water (type)")[Pokémon](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_(species) "Pokémon (species)") introduced in [Generation I](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Generation_I "Generation I").

It [evolves](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Evolution "Evolution") into [Golduck](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Golduck_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Golduck (Pokémon)") starting at [level](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Level "Level") 33.

## Biology

Psyduck is a yellow [Pokémon](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_(species) "Pokémon (species)") resembling a [duck](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/duck "wp:duck") or a bipedal [platypus](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/platypus "wp:platypus"). On top of its head are three thick strands of black hair, and it has a wide, flat cream-colored beak. Psyduck's eyes seem vacant and have tiny pupils. Its legs and tail are stubby, and it has cream-colored webbed feet. There are three claws on each of its hands.

Psyduck is constantly stunned by its [headache](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/headache "wp:headache") and is unable to think very clearly. It usually stands immobile, trying to calm its headache. However, when its headache becomes too severe, Psyduck releases tension in the form of strong psychic powers. The use of these powers produces brain waves identical to those seen in sleepers, and the Pokémon is unable to recall these episodes. Psyduck lives in [freshwater lakes](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/List_of_Pok%C3%A9mon_by_habitat#Water's-edge_Pok%C3%A9mon "List of Pokémon by habitat") and small ponds, but can be seen in rivers in tropical areas as shown in [Pokémon Snap](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_Snap "Pokémon Snap"). As mentioned in [Pokémon Sleep](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_Sleep "Pokémon Sleep"), Psyduck suffers headaches while it sleeps,[[1]](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Psyduck_(Pok%C3%A9mon)#cite_note-1) but very rarely, there have been sightings of Psyduck sleeping peacefully while not holding its head.

Prior to [Generation V](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Generation_V "Generation V"), Psyduck and its evolved form, [Golduck](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Golduck_(Pok%C3%A9mon) "Golduck (Pokémon)"), were the [only known Pokémon](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Signature_Ability "Signature Ability") that could have [Cloud Nine](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Cloud_Nine_(Ability) "Cloud Nine (Ability)") as an [Ability](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Ability "Ability").
